integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by a complete finite reconstruction of the simplicial complex and an explicit acyclic discrete-Morse matching, with a separate mod-2 homology cross-check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement for the Petersen graph at \(k=3\) only; no classification of cubic graphs or all \(k\) is asserted. Originality is relative to inspected and searched literature and may miss an unindexed computation under different terminology.
title: The Petersen total \(3\)-cut complex is a wedge of nine \(4\)-spheres
